_doc: A sample of sign-up offers, loaded by `seed` and shown on the Offers page until the catalogue run reads the current ones. Read on the date in `checked` from milelion.com, mainlymiles.com and the banks' own pages; the promotion terms were not all read, so check an offer with the bank. existing = who the offer is for. cardup = whether a payment through CardUp counts toward the minimum spend. cents_per_mile = (minimum spend x 2.45% CardUp fee + any payable annual fee) / bonus miles, the sum catalogue.offer_cost makes.

cards.name: AMEX KrisFlyer Credit Card
cards.existing: new-to-AMEX customers only; an AMEX card issued by a bank does not count as holding one

cards.name: UOB Visa Infinite Metal
cards.fee: S$654, payable (25,000 of the bonus miles are for paying it)
cards.existing: existing UOB cardholders get 40,000 miles; customers new to UOB get 60,000

cards.name: Citi Prestige
cards.window: by end of 2nd month after approval

cards.name: HSBC TravelOne (or Revolution)
cards.fee: S$196.20, payable (Revolution: no annual fee, 16,800 miles)
cards.cardup: does not count: HSBC cards earn nothing on CardUp
